admission.justification: Omitting post-registration compaction or running it out of order relative to explainer registration and role narrowing leaves uncompacted tool schemas and clips Manager tools above the 48,312 B pack cap; guarded by server parity, budget, and stdio tests.

applicability: Applies to every MCPServer server constructed by create_server(config) in mcp/src/agents_remember/mcp/server.py across unbound, role-bound, and explainer configurations.
conditions: create_server enables listing-time compaction via _compact_server_tool_schemas(server) after registration-time read-only classification and before _bound_role_tools / _scope_server_tools.
AgentsRememberMCP.list_tools returns compacted inputSchema copies on each public tools/list answer while leaving stored SDK tool definitions unmutated.
exclusions: Does not alter runtime Pydantic argument validation, tool registration order, read-only annotations, or role allowlists.
statement: AgentsRememberMCP.list_tools compacts every advertised tool's inputSchema on copied MCPTool instances when create_server enables compaction after registration-time read-only classification and before role narrowing, covering unbound, role-bound, and explainer surfaces without mutating stored SDK tool definitions or changing runtime validation, tool order, or read-only annotations.
title: AgentsRememberMCP.list_tools compacts advertised schemas without mutating tools
